WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(day)) AS first_m,
           date_trunc('month', MAX(day)) AS last_m
    FROM sales_daily
),
months AS (
    SELECT generate_series(first_m, last_m, interval '1 month') AS m
    FROM bounds
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT mo.m, COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) AS total
    FROM months mo
    LEFT JOIN sales_daily s ON date_trunc('month', s.day) = mo.m
    GROUP BY mo.m
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT m, total, LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY m) AS prev_total
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_total IS NOT NULL
  AND total > prev_total
